summary: We have developed a globe that has six key cities that demonstrate the effects of climate change. We have used data from NASA to base our variables which will determine the sound of the music. The music is compiled between three different audio tracks which each player at individual volumes depending on the value for each metric.
details: Our project features 6 key cities with environmental values from each year. It uses audio to allow people who are hard of hearing to better understand climate change throughout the 21st century. We coded the project in CSS and uploaded it as a website via StackBlitz. I believe the project is creative due to the use of multiple audio tracks from different parts of nature to represent the change. We had to consider what a "normal" range would be in order to provide accurate volumes for each track.
